_comment: WP-24BF*15 PCB template. All dimensions in INCHES, origin (0,0) at board center.
_note_1: PDF drawing includes .031 clearance from interior of WP-24BF*15.

corners._comment: CONCAVE scoop corners. At each corner the board outline takes a bite OUT of the enclosing rectangle to clear the case's lid-screw bosses. The mounting hole at (±2.597, ±1.789) sits in the TAB — the material that remains inside of the scoop, adjacent to the top/bottom edge. Walk (CW at TR corner): top edge → sharp convex corner at (+2.826, +2.218) → vertical wall down at X=+2.826 → R.300 concave arc (arc center inside the scoop, outside the board) → horizontal floor at Y=+1.490 → sharp convex corner at (+3.202, +1.490) → right edge.
corners._top_edge_end_x_source: User confirmed 2026-07-06: top edge Y=+2.218 spans X=[-2.826, +2.826]. Beyond ±2.826 the scoop begins.
corners._side_edge_start_y_source: 2X 1.490. Right/left edge X=±3.202 spans Y=[-1.490, +1.490]. Beyond ±1.490 the scoop begins.
corners._arc_center_y_derived_source: side_edge_start_y + arc_radius = 1.490 + 0.300. Note this exactly matches the mounting hole Y=1.789 to within 0.001 — near-coincident with the hole row.
corners._vertical_wall_length_derived_source: top edge Y - arc entry Y = 2.218 - 1.790
corners._horizontal_floor_length_derived_source: half_width - arc_center_x = 3.202 - 3.126. NOTE: exactly matches R.076 fillet radius. Once R.076 fillet is added at the convex floor/side-edge corner, this straight is consumed entirely, leaving vertical wall + R.300 + R.076 to right edge.

fillets._comment: Small R.076 fillets. 8X per PDF = 2 per corner × 4 corners. Likely at the transitions between top/bottom edges and the corner region, but their exact positions are ambiguous from sheet 4 alone. DEFERRED for initial render — the corner as straight-arc-straight is manufacturable without them. Fab will cut sharp inner angles cleanly.

notches._comment: Alignment relief cuts for internal case ribs. 3 on top edge + 3 on bottom edge + 1 on each side = 8 total. All 0.262" wide, 0.069" deep.
notches._width_source: 2X 0.131 half-widths (0.131 + 0.131) at multiple positions on top edge
notches._top_x_centers_source: Center notch at X=0 (2X 0.131 → ±0.131 half-width). Inner notches centered at ±(1.542+1.804)/2 = ±1.673.
notches._left_y_centers_source: 2X 0.131 pair on the left/right edges → single notch centered at Y=0

antenna_notch._comment: Edge notch on the top edge that (a) clears the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1's 7 mm antenna keep-out AND (b) is deep enough (0.069") to clear the same lid-mounting boss column that the standard case-rib notches are for. The module sits with its antenna end pointing at the top edge. x_span (along the top edge) 20 mm × y_depth (into the board) 8.7526 mm = 20 × 8.75 mm horizontal slot.
antenna_notch._x_span_source: 20 mm = 0.7874" — user directive 2026-07-06. X extent of the notch mouth along the top edge.
antenna_notch._y_depth_source: 7 mm antenna keep-out + 0.069" boss clearance = 8.7526 mm = 0.3446". Y drop from the top edge into the board.
antenna_notch._left_x_source: board left edge -3.202" + 30 mm (1.181") = -2.021". User: 'left edge of the antenna notch is 30 mm from the left edge of the board'
_notes: Overlaps standard case-rib notch at X centered on -1.673 (spans -1.804 to -1.542). The standard notch is subsumed by the antenna notch: when emitting the top edge, the -1.673 case-rib notch is skipped in favor of the deeper antenna notch. The remaining top-edge case-rib notches at X=0 and X=+1.673 are unchanged.
Mounting hole at (-2.597, +1.789) is safe: notch X-range [-2.021, -1.234] does not reach -2.597, so the hole is entirely west of the notch.

mounting_holes._comment: 6X Ø.135 in PDF. User directive: use only the 4 CORNER holes at (±2.597, ±1.789). Ignore the 2 inner holes. Each corner hole sits on the corner tab under the truncated top/bottom edge (spans X=±2.826) and clear of the truncated side edge (starts at ±1.490).

positions._label: TR — user confirmed 2026-07-06: mounting hole X at 2.597

mounting_holes._ignored_inner_holes: 2 mid-edge holes skipped per user direction

kicad_placement._comment: Origin (0,0) in IR maps to this KiCad canvas point in mm. Only used by the KiCad renderer.
